$comment: Known high/critical advisories CI accepts for now. Each needs a reason and an expiry; CI fails once it expires, so it gets re-checked. See scripts/ci/audit.mjs.

exceptions.reason: Only reached through expo-router > query-string@7, which require()s it; the fixed 0.5.1 is ESM-only, and npm's fix is expo-router 58 (Expo SDK 58). Worst case is a slow decode of a crafted nomaddays:// link on the user's own phone; the app has no server or network access. Remove with the SDK 58 upgrade.
